name: Click Snap
description: Holds early clicks and fires them on the last step where they still work.

max-early.name: Max early steps
max-early.description: How many physics steps a click may be held back. Late clicks are never moved.

lookahead.name: Lookahead steps
lookahead.description: How far ahead each test simulation runs. Higher = safer, but heavier on CPU.

time-limit-ms.name: Slow limit (ms)
time-limit-ms.description: If one test simulation takes longer than this, buffering pauses for a few seconds. Raise it on big levels (costs FPS).

debug.name: Debug log
debug.description: Writes what Click Snap is doing to the Geode log.
